# 🔥 Toasty Trails

_A refined vanilla experience with powerful quality-of-life improvements._

# 💻 Minimum System Requirements

To ensure a smooth and stable experience while playing Toasty Trails, the following system specifications are recommended.

## Minimum Requirements

CPU: Intel Core i3 (8th Gen) / AMD Ryzen 3 or equivalent

RAM: 4 GB allocated to Minecraft

GPU: Integrated graphics or any GPU supporting OpenGL 4.5

Storage: 2–3 GB of free disk space

Java: Java 21 recommended

## Recommended Specifications

CPU: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or better

RAM: 6–8 GB allocated to Minecraft

GPU: Dedicated graphics card recommended for smoother gameplay

Storage: SSD recommended for faster world loading and improved performance

# 🌟 About the Modpack

Toasty Trails is a carefully curated Quality-of-Life Minecraft modpack designed to enhance the overall gameplay experience while preserving the familiar charm of vanilla Minecraft.

Featuring 130+ thoughtfully selected mods, this modpack focuses on improving performance, usability, and convenience without drastically altering the core mechanics of the game. Every mod included in Toasty Trails has been chosen to refine gameplay and remove common frustrations while maintaining the authentic Minecraft feel.

Instead of transforming Minecraft into something completely different, Toasty Trails aims to polish and improve what already makes the game enjoyable. The result is a smoother, more efficient, and more immersive experience that still feels like the classic Minecraft players know and love.

# ⚙️ Features
## 🚀 Performance Improvements

Toasty Trails includes multiple optimizations designed to improve performance and stability.

Improved FPS and rendering performance

Faster game startup and world loading

Better memory usage and resource management

Optimized gameplay for smoother performance on a wide range of systems

## 🧰 Quality-of-Life Enhancements

The modpack introduces numerous small improvements that make everyday gameplay more convenient.

Improved inventory and item management

Better interface and visual feedback

More intuitive controls and gameplay improvements

Helpful tweaks that make exploration and survival easier

## 🌿 Vanilla-Friendly Design

One of the core goals of Toasty Trails is to preserve the vanilla Minecraft experience.

Gameplay remains balanced and familiar

No drastic changes to core mechanics

Enhancements feel natural and integrated with vanilla gameplay

## 🔧 Carefully Curated Mod Selection

Each mod has been selected to ensure compatibility and stability.

130+ mods working together seamlessly

Stable and optimized configuration

Minimal conflicts and consistent performance

# 🧭 Who This Modpack Is For

Toasty Trails is ideal for players who want:

A better vanilla Minecraft experience

Performance improvements and smoother gameplay

Helpful enhancements without overwhelming changes

A polished and refined version of Minecraft

Whether you enjoy building, exploring, surviving, or simply relaxing in your world, this modpack enhances the experience without removing the simplicity and creativity that make Minecraft unique.

# 📦 Modpack Details

Total Mods: 130+

Loader: Fabric

Focus: Quality-of-Life Improvements

Gameplay Style: Vanilla-Friendly

Performance: Optimized for smoother gameplay

# 🏁 Conclusion

Toasty Trails is designed to deliver a smoother, more refined version of Minecraft without losing the essence of the original game. By combining performance improvements, helpful quality-of-life features, and a carefully curated selection of mods, the pack creates a gameplay experience that feels familiar yet significantly improved.

Whether you are a new player or a long-time Minecraft enthusiast, Toasty Trails offers a polished and enjoyable adventure that enhances the journey without changing the destination.

_Explore, build, survive, and create — all while enjoying a better, optimized, and more convenient Minecraft experience. 🔥_
